verdict.rationale: Salesforce documents its own programmatic surface: platform APIs ('Discover Salesforce APIs'), an official CLI that can query data and create agents and orgs, and a community note praising its command-line and developer tooling. Nothing in the pack shows that everything doable in the UI is also doable through the API, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of API/UI parity, API coverage of Sales Cloud objects and actions, a published machine-readable API spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Discover Salesforce APIs & put them to work.
With SFDC I get a passable command line tool, multiple VS Code extensions, an easy deployment path
